answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in cipher and island lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the nebula graph. A farm of 4083 identities would post 2056 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
